name: OC Intelligent Lamination System
summary: Fully automatic precision assembly of Open Cell and backlight modules. Utilizes UVW vision alignment platform to completely eliminate screen breakage issues caused by manual lamination.
contentHtml:
The OC Intelligent Lamination System is an automated equipment developed by TXAM for the core processes of display panel production.

Working Principle

The equipment uses a UVW vision alignment platform to automatically identify product positions and guide the robot to complete precision assembly of OC and backlight modules. The fully automatic process includes automatic feeding, foam collection, and empty box collection.

Technical Advantages

  • Lamination accuracy ranges from ±0.15mm to ±0.4mm
  • Fixed cycle time of 25 seconds ensures production rhythm
  • Completely eliminates screen breakage issues caused by manual lamination
  • One-click product changeover reduces changeover time

Model Description

The TXM-A series includes models such as 151B, 201B, and 401B, with the main differences being compatible product sizes and lamination accuracy.
